title: Maximize Number Of Subsequences In A String
statement:
Given lowercase string `text` and two-character `pattern`, insert exactly one copy of either pattern character at any position. Return the maximum number of `pattern` subsequences in the resulting string. Subsequences are counted by their index choices.

## Examples

```text
Input: text = "abdcdbc", pattern = "ac"
Output: 4
```

```text
Input: text = "aabb", pattern = "ab"
Output: 6
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= text.length <= 10^5`
- `pattern.length == 2`
- `text` and `pattern` contain lowercase English letters
